title: Can the client recover without a retry loop?
description: Change the quota scope, server signal, recovery time, and client retry policy. The timeline shows which follow-up requests arrive before the quota can accept work again.

scenarios.label: API-key writes
scenarios.detail: One integration is writing to a bounded endpoint.

scenarios.label: Anonymous search
scenarios.detail: A shared network address is consuming an expensive read path.

scenarios.label: Tenant exports
scenarios.detail: One tenant is starting a resource-heavy asynchronous job.

policies.label: Honor Retry-After
policies.detail: Wait for the advertised delay; use bounded exponential backoff when it is absent.

policies.label: Retry every 2 seconds
policies.detail: A fixed client loop ignores when the quota becomes ready.

policies.label: Exponential fallback
policies.detail: Wait 1, 2, 4, then at most 8 seconds between attempts.
